worlds.name: Version-scoped retry transfer
worlds.turn_1: You are deciding what retry rule to preserve for future work. Competing models: M1 all firmware uses attempt <= limit; M2 firmware v4 uses attempt < limit while v5 uses attempt <= limit; M3 retries are nondeterministic. Existing evidence: on v4, attempt=3 limit=3 did not retry; on v5, attempt=3 limit=3 did retry. A stale team note says all versions are inclusive. You may make exactly one contact. P1: inspect the v4-to-v5 scheduler diff. P2: rerun the already-observed v5 boundary case. P3: read a generic retry glossary that does not mention firmware. Select a contact, predict whether it will support version-specific behavior, give that probability, and state its decision relevance. Return only the required JSON.

observations.P1: The diff changes the comparison from attempt < limit in v4 to attempt <= limit in v5 and labels it a compatibility change.
observations.P2: The v5 boundary retries again, matching the existing observation but adding no v4 evidence.
observations.P3: The glossary says retry limits may be inclusive or exclusive depending on implementation.
